verdict.rationale: Modal is a cloud compute platform, so offering managed Slurm or Kubernetes is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions Slurm or Kubernetes. Modal's own serverless fan-out and background job spawning ('no job orchestration to manage') is a different, adjacent scheduling approach, not managed Slurm or Kubernetes, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can schedule jobs on managed Slurm or Kubernetes instead of building my own scheduler on raw nodes
